stories.title: City anti-social behaviour order set to be expanded
stories.summary: The order would cover areas such as Westcotes, Frog Island, Belgrave, Spinney Hills and Highfields.

stories.title: Elderly man suffers head injury in e-bike crash
stories.summary: The rider of the e-bike stopped before leaving the scene, Leicestershire Police said.

stories.title: Space team's joy as craft nears Mercury
stories.summary: Scientists at the University of Leicester are preparing to receive the first data from the mission.

stories.title: Work to upgrade college facilities set to take place
stories.summary: The college says improvements are expected to be completed by mid-March 2027.

stories.title: Stalking law changed after review led by man who prosecuted Leicestershire woman's murderer
stories.summary: The new stalking offence will be introduced after a review found existing legislation was confusing.

stories.title: Man jailed for causing wrong-way police chase crash
stories.summary: Niks Rogacs was jailed for four and a half years at Leicester Crown Court on Wednesday.

stories.title: M&S to fight council's £419k business rates claim
stories.summary: The council says the retailer owes £419,633 of business rates linked to its former store.

stories.title: Leicester no longer for sale as owner refocuses on future
stories.summary: Leicester owner Khun Aiyawatt 'Top' Srivaddhanaprabha confirms the one-time Premier League title winners are no longer up for sale.

stories.title: Huge fly-tip grew undetected over several months
stories.summary: The council says the 20-tonne pile of rubbish was dumped over garden fences.

stories.title: Singer with cancer to switch on Christmas lights
stories.summary: Bethany, 15, says she is "excited" to be turning on Coalville's annual Christmas lights on Saturday.

stories.title: UK's oldest living heart transplant recipient dies
stories.summary: Ted Warner had a heart transplant in 1990 - and lived for another 36 years.

stories.title: Item that prompted A&E evacuation was e-bike charger
stories.summary: A 44-year-old man was arrested at the scene on suspicion of immigration offences.
